snippet.title: Dance Dance Incremental [Official Announcement Trailer]
snippet.description:
You've found a mystical mp3 player! Pop notes, download rare tunes, and dance like its the year 2000. Dance Dance Incremental is a groovy incremental game inspired by DDR, Tamagotchi, Windows Media Player, and the Y2K era.

Wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4658230/Dance_Dance_Incremental/

♪┏(・o･)┛♪┗ ( ･o･) ┓♪
